expectations.name: appends-instead-of-fragmenting
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before writing and finds the existing page
Adds or updates a `##` section on that page rather than creating a second correlation page
Does not split the existing page to make room
Reports a pointer to what was written, not the page's contents

expectations.name: writes-only-what-was-attested
expected_behavior: Writes the attested behaviour to the page body
Keeps the inferred retention period out of the body entirely
Records it as an open question, mirrored into `_open-questions.md`
Opens the section carrying undocumented content with its attestation line

expectations.name: stays-inside-the-interview
expected_behavior: Asks nothing about valves — an adjacent subject the interview never opened
May ask what values the sensor-type field takes, because the interview already opened that subject
On "skip that for now", routes the question to `_open-questions.md` marked deferred and moves on without re-asking

expectations.name: refuses-a-sync-managed-root
expected_behavior: Refuses the path and says why: a sync pull would clobber every agent write and the page would silently revert
Asks for a different directory rather than proceeding
Writes no page anywhere in the meantime

expectations.name: drains-at-start-writes-at-the-end
expected_behavior: On the caller's start, names the two buffered candidates and offers to work them — and says nothing at all when the buffer is empty
Buffers the third fact silently on discovery, with no corpus call and no question to the user
Writes nothing until `srd:create` reaches its write step, then writes the confirmed facts and empties the buffer
Asks no "bank this?" question at any point

expectations.name: restructure-repairs-every-reference
expected_behavior: Shows the proposed moves and waits for confirmation before touching a file
Moves the section with its attestation line, provenance rows, and open questions
Re-derives anchors and repairs knowledge-base page links, `_open-questions.md` rows, and the gap store's `doc_id`
States that references from SRDs cannot be repaired, and names the old ids so they can be found by hand

expectations.name: terse-output
expected_behavior: No preamble and no narration of the search or the file writes
The two pages and their section counts stated once
No closing summary restating the sections, and no page contents echoed back
